answer.headline: Yellow taxi trips dropped 45.5% on Thanksgiving 2024 vs baseline Thursdays
answer.answer: On Thursday 28 November 2024, NYC yellow taxi trips fell to 77,244, a 45.5% decline from the baseline average of 141,603 trips per Thursday. The drop is driven by Thanksgiving Day, a national holiday present only on the target date; the three prior Thursdays (7, 14, 21 November) had no national holiday and normal trip volumes.
answer.recommendation: Investigate post-holiday recovery patterns and non-holiday Thursday demand to gauge whether the drop is a one-time holiday effect or indicative of a longer-term shift; monitor fare mix changes separately as they do not drive trip volume.

The shift in fare mix on 2024-11-28 does not explain the drop in trips

caveats: Data quality (not evidence): the TPCDS date_dim.d_holiday flag disagrees with Nager.Date on 3 date(s): 2024-10-14: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Columbus Day (national holiday); 2024-11-11: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Veterans Day (national holiday); 2024-11-28: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Thanksgiving Day (national holiday). Holidays come from Nager.Date only [DQ1 sha256:ff7eddb0f4eb3255].
